source_manifest.method: SHA-256 of sorted repository path, NUL, file bytes, NUL; runtime includes all src/db and package/build/test config; all_source also includes all scripts/tests. Private files and documentation are excluded.

implemented.conversation_context: Fresh selected-calendar and Inbox facts, at most 20 events and 12 message previews across selected sources; bounded selected-message text on demand, lower trust than fixed policy. Source freshness, omissions, partial and failed reads remain explicit.
implemented.confirmation: Exact account/recipients/content/title/time review. Voice requires completed playback and exact immediately subsequent confirmation; touch shares the same server commands.
implemented.durability: Encrypted payload/provider identifiers in existing append-only tables; a unique committed claim precedes provider mutations. Known immutable draft/event IDs support read-only reconciliation. No blind resend/reinvite after uncertainty.
implemented.scope_changes: Microsoft selection/state/consent participate in inference binding. Changed authority ends incompatible conversation and pending voice review.

full_suite.scope_note: Full runtime regression completed before two additional final concurrency/HTTP test cases were added. Those two cases subsequently pass in the focused suite and actual PostgreSQL run; do not present this as 942 tests in one full-suite invocation.

disposable_live_checks.conversation_test_method: Typed question through the existing authenticated Talk to Nancy client, actual configured reasoning and local speech route. Browser text showed the correct test event time. This is not physical-device/person acceptance.
